Boston: Studio Allston Hotel — $155.50/night, 8.2/10 | DoubleTree by Hilton Boston-Downtown — $165.50/night, 8.4/10

Uniform admission rule: ≥8.0/10, ≥100 reviews, and no unresolved recent pattern involving cleanliness, nighttime noise, or maintenance. The result cards did not show review counts or the required recent-review evidence. They also did not show breakfast, room type, tax/mandatory-fee basis, or cancellation terms. Therefore every hotel remains a candidate—not a qualified recommendation—until procurement captures complete evidence.
